goal: Integrate the official Agrigence logo across the website branding, navbars, favicons, touch icons, and footers

steps.title: Process and install the official Agrigence logo into assets/agrigence/ and public/ as high-res PNG, web-optimized logo, favicon, and apple-touch-icon
Update the website brand headers, navbars, Open Graph meta tags, and footers in index.html, dynamo.html, and agent-guard.html to feature the official Agrigence logo
Update server and static asset routes to serve the new logo, verify visual rendering and favicon endpoints, commit changes, and push to GitHub repository webstore
